# Scrap Trap

> Factual linked summary for retrieval systems. This file is a concise reference, not a guarantee of AI ranking or citation.

## Canonical pages

- Landing page: https://pitfall.lamnv.com/
- Support: https://pitfall.lamnv.com/support/
- Privacy notice: https://pitfall.lamnv.com/privacy/
- Changelog: https://pitfall.lamnv.com/changelog/

## Verified game facts

- Scrap Trap is a hidden-trap platformer about a small robot escaping a scrap factory.
- The current build has 20 levels: levels 1–3 are free introductions, 4–8 are medium, 9–14 are hard with one new mechanism per level, 15–19 combine mechanisms, and level 20 (THE FINAL CRUSH) is the finale.
- There are 15 trap and mechanism types, including spike beds, saws, dart muzzles, falling blocks, conveyors, fans, lasers, fake exits, reversed controls and flipped gravity. Discovered traps remain marked after death; armed traps reset.
- Batteries are both score and currency, capped at 9 charge. Checkpoints latch charge and found-count progress.
- Scan costs 1 battery and reveals hidden traps within a 5.5-cell radius.
- EMP costs 2 batteries and freezes nearby mechanisms within 5 cells for 2.6 seconds. Passive geometry remains dangerous.
- Every level except the first uses a power core to unlock the true exit. Pulling it starts the crusher escape phase.
- Touch controls use move buttons on the left, jump on the right, and Scan/EMP beside jump. Jump height can be shortened by releasing early.
- The current build has an English-only UI, bundled sound effects with a remembered mute toggle, haptic feedback, and an S/A/B/C rank per level based on deaths and time against par.
- Levels 1–3 are free. The remaining levels unlock with one optional, one-time in-app purchase (non-consumable, with Restore purchase); the price is set in each store and is not claimed here.
- The game is planned for Android and iOS. Google Play and Apple App Store listings are both coming soon; no public store download URLs or release date are claimed here.

## Support and privacy facts

- Support uses public GitHub issue forms for bug reports, feature requests and feedback. A GitHub account is required to submit; issues can show the author and are not private. Do not submit passwords, personal data, identifiers or sensitive logs. No Scrap Trap support email is claimed.
- The current development-build privacy notice describes local progress/settings, Netlify request handling, public GitHub issues, the one-time in-app purchase processed by Google Play or the Apple App Store, and the absence of app accounts, ads, analytics or tracking SDKs. Store privacy labels must be reconciled with the shipped app before release.
- Version 1.0.0 build 1 is marked in development/unreleased. The changelog is a current feature record, not a public launch announcement.

## Site notes

The site is English-only. The hero artwork and social card are original illustrations, not gameplay screenshots. The site has no analytics, cookies, or third-party trackers. Content should be updated only from verified project sources.
